about: Narration test suite for FIN-886 (structure-aware narration). Run with `.build/debug/ReadAloud --test-narration Tests/narration/cases.json [--verbose]`. Each case parses `input` as `format` (markdown | html | plain | auto, where auto is the detection PlayerModel uses without html), plans it, and compares the spoken chunks: `speech` exactly, `speed` within 0.001 (omitted = 1), `pause` within 0.005 or `pauseMin`/`pauseMax` (omitted = not checked), and the chunk count. `display` (optional) is the exact display text; `detect` (optional) is the expected auto-detected format; `html` (optional) is the app's HTML beside `input`, read as the player reads them. Written from the spec alone: pauses follow its table with max() between blocks (paragraph after 0.75, so a paragraph before a list is 0.75; the 0.6 list and quote entries show after an h3/h4), 0.25 between sentences, 0.5 after the last chunk. A pause after the last row of a table that is followed by something else is left unchecked (the spec doesn't define it); the gap after a splitOpening piece may be anything from 0.02 (today) to 0.08 (pieces of one sentence). Plain-text guards must stay paragraphs: no headings or lists in emails, chat, poems, addresses, URLs or numbered sentences.
